properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] OAuth Device-Code Consent Phish to Cross-IP Cloud Token Replay
properties.description:
Detects the EvilTokens / Storm-2949 consent-phishing chain: a successful Entra ID device-code authentication (or an OAuth consent grant to a non-Microsoft first-party app) is followed within 60 minutes by privileged cloud activity from a DIFFERENT source IP / ASN than the one that initiated the device-code request, where 'privileged activity' means mass mailbox/SharePoint reads, inbox-rule creation, app-credential or device-registration manipulation, or token use against Graph from a new ASN. This fortnight the pattern is driven by 'The New Phishing Click: How OAuth Consent Bypasses MFA' (EvilTokens PhaaS, 340+ M365 tenants in 5 weeks), 'How Storm-2949 turned a compromised identity into a cloud-wide breach' (token-theft-led cloud exfil to T1530/T1567.002), and the phishing-exposure pieces from THN and BleepingComputer. The chain spans delivery (phish link / pasted device code), exploit/persistence (T1528 token theft, T1098.001 credential add), and actions (T1550.001 token replay, cloud data theft). It fires when both stages match across IPs; it does NOT fire on legitimate device-code logons from kiosks / Teams Rooms / headless devices where the subsequent token use occurs from the same egress IP, nor on conditional-access-blocked attempts (those never produce a downstream success).

Rationale: Every article in scope converges on stolen-token cloud abuse — EvilTokens (device-code consent PhaaS), Storm-2949 (identity-to-cloud breach), and the THN/Bleeping pieces on phishing-driven session theft all rely on the SAME post-auth tell: a legitimate-looking Entra sign-in (device code / OAuth consent) is replayed from attacker infrastructure to take privileged actions within minutes. Joining the auth event to the downstream privileged action AND requiring a source-IP mismatch within 60 minutes catches the campaign pattern even when IOCs (apps, IPs, code-paste lures) rotate.
properties.query:
// Sentinel — SigninLogs (device-code / OAuth consent) joined to AuditLogs + OfficeActivity
let WindowMin = 60m;
let Lookback = 7d;
let ConsentAuth =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode"
         or tostring(AuthenticationDetails) has "deviceCode"
    | project AuthTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, UserId,
              AuthIp = IPAddress, AuthCountry = LocationDetails.countryOrRegion,
              AuthApp = AppDisplayName, SessionId = CorrelationId;
let PrivAuditAct =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where OperationName in~ (
        "Add service principal credentials",
        "Consent to application",
        "Add owner to application",
        "Add app role assignment grant to user",
        "Update application – Certificates and secrets management",
        "Add member to role",
        "Register device")
    | extend Upn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
             ActIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project ActTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName = Upn, ActIp,
              ActionType = OperationName, Target = tostring(TargetResources);
let PrivOfficeAct =
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Add-MailboxPermission",
                           "FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull","MailItemsAccessed")
    | project ActTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName = UserId,
              ActIp = ClientIP, ActionType = Operation, Target = OfficeObjectId;
let PrivAct = union PrivAuditAct, PrivOfficeAct;
ConsentAuth
| join kind=inner (PrivAct) on UserPrincipalName
| where ActTime between (AuthTime .. AuthTime + WindowMin)
| where tostring(AuthIp) != tostring(ActIp)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ActTime, AuthTime)
| summarize ActionCount = count(),
            Actions = make_set(ActionType, 25),
            FirstAct = min(ActTime),
            LastAct = max(ActTime),
            ActIps = make_set(ActIp, 10)
            by AuthTime, UserPrincipalName, AuthIp, tostring(AuthCountry), AuthApp, SessionId
| order by FirstAct desc
